title: The phone app updates itself: the bridge says a new build is out, the app downloads the APK from the R2 link and opens Android's installer

fields.why: adb over Wi-Fi keeps failing on the Mac, and TJ uses the phone away from home. TJ: 'i love phone updating itself for sure'.

text: App: mobile/android (Compose). Laptop link: mobile/bridge/bridge.mjs + lib.mjs via mobile/relay; bridge is launch agent com.genlock.phone-bridge. Builds upload with mobile/ship_android.sh to R2 (fixed secret URL, token in ~/.genlock_ship). Bridge reports latest shipped version; app compares its own, shows Update, downloads, installs via package installer (REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES, FileProvider). Keep the debug signing key. Build needs JDK17 at ~/dev-tools/jdk17. Never install on a phone TJ did not name.
